_comment: A complete RFQ clarification round, both sides of it: five queries raised by
three shortlisted vendors, and Astra's answers, restriction, withdrawal and
addendum. Played against a running API by tools/mock_clarification_round.py.
The companies here are the invented Astra cast from workflow/seed_demo.py, not
real vendors, and nothing in this file is a record of anything that happened.
The questions are written the way real bid queries read because a mock that
reads as filler exercises the screens without exercising the judgement they
The `expect_gate` steps are the point of the file. They assert what the
Clarifications exit gate says at three moments: with a query open AND an
addendum in draft (both halves of the sentence), with only the draft left, and
with nothing outstanding. A data-only fixture would load and prove nothing.

rfq.package: Field transmitters and 11 kV feeder cable

item.description: Pressure and differential pressure transmitters, battery limit

technical_package.basis_of_design: Battery-limit field transmitters to instrument index Rev. A, plus the substation feeder cable to the cable schedule Rev. A.

exchange.question: Datasheet RUU-DS-412 calls for Ex ia IIC T4 on all transmitters. Is a current IECEx certificate sufficient on its own, or is an ATEX certificate also required for this site? Please confirm whether the certificate must name the exact model offered.
Clause 14.3 states liquidated damages at 0.5% per week but does not state a cap. Please confirm the aggregate cap on LDs and whether it is inclusive of any performance-related deductions.

Our standard transmitter for the 0-16 bar range is supplied with a 316L stainless wetted diaphragm rather than the Hastelloy C-276 called for in the index. Confirm whether 316L is acceptable for the utility water service lines, or whether we should price the C-276 variant across all tags.
The ITB states a bid validity of 90 days while the covering letter states 120 days. Please confirm which governs, and confirm the date from which validity is counted.
Confirm the maximum drum length available for the 11 kV feeder and whether straight joints are permitted in the buried trench run between the substation and the battery limit.

exchange.answer: IECEx alone is acceptable for this site; ATEX is not required. The certificate must be current at bid submission and must name the exact model and range offered. A certificate covering a product family without the offered model will be treated as non-compliant.
Price the Hastelloy C-276 variant across all tags. 316L is not acceptable on the utility water service lines; the chloride content at site conditions is outside its limit.
exchange.restricted_reason: The question names this bidder's own offered diaphragm material and the answer would disclose their proposed deviation to the rest of the shortlist. Restricted by procurement; the underlying material requirement is unchanged and already stated in the index.

exchange.answer: Bid validity is 120 days, counted from the revised bid due date. The ITB is in error and will be corrected by addendum.
Maximum drum length is 500 m. One straight joint per drum run is permitted in the trench, subject to the jointing procedure being submitted with the bid.

exchange.reason: Withdrawn at Ras Dana Cables & Conductors' request: the query was raised against the superseded cable schedule, and the drum schedule at Rev. A already states the 500 m limit. The answer above stands but the query is out of the round.
exchange._note: Answered first, then withdrawn. Reads as Withdrawn, not Answered — withdrawal is checked before an answer, and getting that backwards would let the exit gate count a dead question as satisfied.

exchange.summary: Instrument index reissued at Rev. B: wetted material confirmed as Hastelloy C-276 for all tags on the utility water service lines. ITB bid validity corrected to 120 days. Bid due date extended by two weeks.

exchange._note: Both halves of the sentence, because both are true. A reader told only the nearer half retries and is refused again for something nobody mentioned.

exchange.answer: Liquidated damages are capped at 10% of the order value in aggregate, inclusive of performance-related deductions. Clause 14.3 is unchanged.

exchange._note: The nearer half is gone. The gate must now name only the draft.

exchange.reason: Clarification round closed: five queries raised, four answered, one withdrawn, one addendum issued at Rev. B.
